title: MKS Instruments
content: MKS Instruments is a U.S.-based process technology supplier focused on vacuum, pressure, gas delivery, flow control, and related advanced manufacturing systems. These capabilities are relevant to controlled processing environments that intersect with aerogel-adjacent materials development and scale-up. MKS is a strong upstream Equipment Materials reference for teams evaluating precision process-control infrastructure.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
